firmware.note: The PicoFox runs the vendor's own Arduino firmware (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), not CircuitPython. fox-bench only writes the files that firmware reads. Restoring stock firmware is a UF2 copy.

drive.label: PicoFox
drive.note: The fox does not transmit while a computer has the drive mounted. After writing: eject the drive, then switch the PicoFox off and on.
